name: gauntlet-loop
description: Gauntlet loop: write a short prompt that sets a real quality bar, then run builder/critic pairs until the work wins.

interface.shortDescription: Loop builder/critic pairs until the work beats a real bar
interface.longDescription: Writes a short prompt that sets a named, fetchable quality bar, then runs builder and critic subagents until the critic picks ours.
defaultPrompt: Use $gauntlet-loop on this goal and run it here after I pick a bar.
